label_mapping.17: Anterior limb of internal capsule R
label_mapping.18: Anterior limb of internal capsule L
label_mapping.19: Posterior limb of internal capsule R
label_mapping.20: Posterior limb of internal capsule L
label_mapping.21: Retrolenticular part of internal capsule R
label_mapping.22: Retrolenticular part of internal capsule L
label_mapping.29: Posterior thalamic radiation (include optic radiation) R
label_mapping.30: Posterior thalamic radiation (include optic radiation) L
label_mapping.31: Sagittal stratum (include inferior longitidinal fasciculus and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus) R
label_mapping.32: Sagittal stratum (include inferior longitidinal fasciculus and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus) L
label_mapping.39: Fornix (cres) / Stria terminalis (can not be resolved with current resolution) R
label_mapping.40: Fornix (cres) / Stria terminalis (can not be resolved with current resolution) L

historical_mapping_note: Labels 31 and 32 are Sagittal stratum and include IFOF in their long names. Labels 45 and 46 are Uncinate fasciculus R/L; there are no separate IFOF labels.
